reading.fields: Four FNV candidate registrations bind type bytes at definition+CC/CD and float2 scales/offsets at+D0/D8. Descriptor tags are3 and11, and the actual producer loads bytes/floats at those offsets.
reading.defaults: The constructor writes little-endian type bytes1/0, then copies literal float4[1,1,0,0] into the scales/offsets block. Legacy/live later overrides remain separate.
reading.producer: The44-byte draw record receives lookup X/Y at+32/+36 through mode-specific paths. Its+0 slot is separately populated by atlas frame logic at1018fc468, not copied directly from normalized lifetime.
reading.consumer: On the checked inline28-byte packet branch (context byte+40 !=1), when each checked UV1 selector takes its null-context branch, CameraQuad and plane load the draw pair, zero the affine coefficients, and use the pair as the base for each corner before FCVT to half at packet+24/+26. Nonnull optional data selects a separate affine path.
reading.scope: This source-only reading does not change local UVs. The already accepted default color DDS is opaque white; its coordinate-independent sampled color supports the existing substitution only under matching binding and sampling.

limits: The alternate packet helper bodies are not attested by this reading. Static field/constructor/producer/conditional-inline-consumer linkage, not actual live emitter selection, UV1 branch admission or shader/material/layout binding.
Constructor defaults do not certify later legacy loader writes, live values or cache mutation. FNV names remain candidates rather than authenticated literal names.
Type2 auxiliary curve and physical vector/clock bindings, type3 random provenance, local phase mapping and native FPCR/FZ/rounding remain unobserved.
